intents.label: NONE
intents.description: The line is neutral, practical, cooperative, or purely friendly.

intents.label: COLD
intents.description: The line is dismissive, cutting, defensive, or pushes the other person away in a way that damages trust or ease.

intents.label: WARM
intents.description: The line reaches toward closeness, emotional openness, or shows vulnerability and trust.

intents.label: FLIRTY
intents.description: The line clearly plays with romantic or charged tension, invitation, teasing intimacy, or direct desire.
